newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Treasuries up, but off highs in late trading.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Treasuries up, but off highs in late trading.

text.p: *US Treasuries pare gains on profit-taking, still end higher
*Bullish sentiment continues. But prices exaggerated by low
volume. GovPX volume just above $50 billion -- GovPX
*Options exiration, hedge fund buying lifts mkt to highs
*Long end buying in futures leads mkt. Yield curve flattens
